content: No matter how high the eagle soars into the sky, it must return to the earth to drink water.
author: African Proverbs
explanation: Worldly success, intellectual brilliance, and elevated titles make people feel as though they float above the ordinary laws of nature. But regardless of your altitude, your mortal body still thirsts, your heart still bleeds, and you will return to the soil. Stay grounded.
practicalInsight: If you experience high praise or victory today, immediately perform a humble, grounding act of service.
reflectionPrompt: How can you maintain deep, humble contact with the earth even when your career or status reaches great heights?
